content:
Talia Benson: Hey all — we keep re-litigating invoice preview every month, so proposing we lock a standard “monthly invoice preview process” w/ owners + deadlines before invoices go out. Goal: no surprises (credits, late usage, meter drift) and clear sign-off trail.

Talia Benson: Draft (PT unless noted):
1) Usage freeze window (data cut): T+1 9:00am — freeze prior month usage for invoicing purposes (late events handled via adjustment policy).
2) Preview package ready: T+2 12:00pm — Finance has preview totals per account + top deltas.
3) Exception triage complete: T+3 3:00pm — Eng + Finance resolve/approve exceptions.
4) Final invoice approval: T+4 12:00pm — CFO/RevRec sign-off.
5) Invoices sent: T+4 EOD.

Talia Benson: Questions: (a) are these timelines realistic given current freshness SLOs? (b) who owns “credits applied correctly” check end-to-end?

Emily Stone: +1 on standardizing. For RevRec we need a hard “cut” for audit trail. Suggest we define freeze as: billing_ledger snapshot at T+1 9am PT, plus a usage-events completeness check (no major partitions missing). Anything after goes into next month unless CFO approves retro.

Laura Bennett: Agree. I want a single artifact every month that shows: usage totals, ledger totals, adjustments/credits, and any known meter incidents affecting the month.

Rishi Malhotra: Timelines mostly fine. For the margin model / anomaly checks, I need the preview numbers by T+2 noon to run “ARPU + GM sanity” (big swings flagged). Otherwise I’m blocking the send.

Mei Lin: Re freshness: current usage_events→ledger pipeline is typically <4h lag, but we’ve seen late arrivals up to ~18h during backfills. If we freeze at T+1 9am PT, we should add a completeness gate: “no partitions older than 6h missing” + “late_event_rate < threshold.”

Mei Lin: I can generate a Snowflake export for preview:
- account_id, day, model, region
- raw_tokens, billed_tokens
- request_count
- cache_hit_tokens (if present)
- ledger_amount_usd
- variance_usd + variance_pct
Owner on export: me.

Logan Wright: From Eng side: I can commit to checking meter drift dashboard + duplicates/null rates before we bless preview. But I need the preview link + query by T+2 morning.

Nadia Rahman: +1. Also we need to explicitly record if shadow billing compare mode was running + whether we’re on old vs new meter for the period. Otherwise we’ll confuse ourselves when numbers differ.

Cole Summers: Credits check: today it’s split (Support issues credits, Finance applies, billing system posts). We should make one owner accountable for “credits reflected in invoice preview.” I suggest Finance (Emily) owns sign-off, with Billing Hooks (me) providing a “credit_applied_at” report from the ledger.

Emily Stone: I can own credits sign-off, but I need a deterministic report. Cole can you provide a query/table that lists credits applied per account for the period + any “pending” credits not picked up?

Cole Summers: Yep. We already have `billing_ledger.credit_adjustments` but it’s not surfaced in the preview pack. I’ll add a saved query + a standard CSV export step. ETA end of week.

Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: Month-end close checklist due in 2 days. Owner: Emily Stone. Link: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/finance/revrec/month-end-close-usage-reconciliation-checklist

Laura Bennett: The freeze window — we need to align with the earlier Slack agreement on late events/backfills. If an incident causes material late usage, it should go through explicit approval (CFO + GC if customer-facing impact).

Michael Grant: +1. Also if we’re changing any usage definitions (token counting / retries) during the window, Legal wants to confirm customer comms + dispute posture. For preview process: add a step “confirm no unapproved meter definition changes affecting invoice month.”

Talia Benson: Good call. Adding a gating question in the preview pack: “Any meter logic changes deployed that affect billed usage for the month? If yes, link PR + approval + whether shadow compare ran.”

Rishi Malhotra: Another practical check: “Top 20 accounts by spend” get manual skim for variance vs prior month (>=20% delta) and any known credits.

Mei Lin: I can auto-generate a “Top accounts variance” tab in the sheet + highlight where variance is driven by model/region mix vs pure usage change.

Logan Wright: What about retries/fallback double-counting? If we detect drift specifically in streaming endpoints, we should pause send for impacted accounts until we confirm ledger is consistent.

Emily Stone: Agree, but we need a crisp stop condition so we don’t boil the ocean. Suggest:
- Blocker if variance between usage_events aggregate and ledger > 1.0% AND > $2k for any top-20 account.
- Warning if >0.5% AND > $500 (document + proceed w/ CFO awareness).

Laura Bennett: Works for me. Put it in writing. And define who gets paged if blocker is hit.

Nadia Rahman: Paging: Eng on-call for telemetry (Logan’s team) + Mei for data export + Emily for Finance triage. We can route via #eng-sre if it’s a pipeline issue.

Talia Benson: Summarizing “Monthly invoice preview process” (v1):
- T+1 9:00am PT: Usage freeze (snapshot billing_ledger + completeness gate). Owner: Emily/Mei.
- T+2 12:00pm PT: Preview pack published (sheet + exports + top variances + credits report + meter-change status). Owner: Mei; reviewer: Emily.
- T+2 EOD: Eng meter health review (drift/dupes/nulls; confirm no unapproved meter changes). Owner: Logan/Nadia.
- T+3 3:00pm PT: Exception triage complete (blocker thresholds as Emily wrote). Owners: Emily + Logan + Mei + Cole.
- T+4 12:00pm PT: Final approval to send. Approvers: Emily (RevRec) + Laura (CFO). Legal consulted if meter definition changes / customer-impacting adjustments (Michael).
- T+4 EOD: Invoices sent.

Talia Benson: I’ll convert this into the formal checklist / runbook, but before I do — any objections to freeze timing / thresholds?

Emily Stone: No objections. Please note timezone in the doc and that “T” is month-end close date (last day of month). Also explicitly call out Stripe vs invoiced contracts (some enterprise in NetSuite) so preview includes both.

Laura Bennett: Approved. Make sure the preview artifact lives in the Finance shared drive with restricted access + audit trail.

Mei Lin: Ack. I’ll template the sheet and pin the Snowflake queries. Will post links in this thread once ready.

Cole Summers: Ack. I’ll add the credits export + “pending credits not yet applied” report and share before next close.

Talia Benson: Great — locking this as v1. Next step: I’ll post a Confluence link for the runbook and we’ll start using it this month.
